dockerfile.description: Golden base images use MOVING tags (daily rebuild) — leave them to golden-image, don't let Renovate pin/bump the Dockerfile FROM lines.

kubernetes.description: Raw k8s manifests carry no upstream images to track (app images are pinned in overlays via the kustomize manager).

argocd.description: Track the Helm chart version referenced by third-party ArgoCD Applications.

customManagers.description: third-party/<name>/chart.env — the Helm chart version used by the validate.sh render + gate.

packageRules.description: In-house app images pinned in the DEV overlays (golden apps registry). Auto-bump; prod is promoted by a human (docs/PROMOTION.md).
Third-party Helm charts — group the ArgoCD Application + chart.env bump into one PR.
